title: UK Generations Study R0 questionnaire (schemify pilot) — shared definitions
description: Only invariant tokens are centralised here; context-specific sentinels are inlined per field because their meanings differ by variable.

missing_numeric.title: Missing or not recorded
missing_numeric.description: The source data has no distinguishing code for why a numeric or coded value is absent — agent-decided sentinel, since BaselineMetadata.xlsx's Answers sheet defines no dedicated missing-value code for these fields. Open for steward confirmation at review.

missing_string.title: Missing or not recorded
missing_string.description: The source data has no distinguishing code for why a string value is absent — agent-decided sentinel, mirroring missing_numeric for string-typed fields. Open for steward confirmation at review.

dont_know.title: Don't know
dont_know.description: The participant indicated they did not know the answer. Harmonised from BaselineMetadata.xlsx's Answers sheet, AnswerID=3 — the same meaning is reused verbatim across 49 answer rows in the source, though the local numeric code varies by question (see each field's own const value).

dont_remember.title: Don't remember
dont_remember.description: The participant indicated they did not remember the answer. Harmonised from BaselineMetadata.xlsx's Answers sheet, AnswerID=5 (6 uses in the source).

not_applicable.title: Not applicable
not_applicable.description: The question did not apply to the participant. Harmonised from BaselineMetadata.xlsx's Answers sheet, AnswerID=6 (9 uses in the source).
